title: Plurals: nouns, articles and adjectives
rule: -o → -i, -a → -e, -e → -i. Articles: il → i, lo and l' (m.) → gli, la and l' (f.) → le. Adjectives take the same endings. Accented and foreign nouns do not change.

blocks.caption: The definite article, singular → plural
head: Singular
Plural
Before

blocks.note: Gli before a vowel is written in full: gli armadi, gli amici (gl'amici is old-fashioned).

head: Pattern
Singular → plural
Note
rows: armadio → armadi · figlio → figli · orologio → orologi
two i's because the i carries the stress
tedesco → tedeschi · albergo → alberghi · stanco → stanchi
no h, sound goes soft; amico is the famous exception
arancia → arance · spiaggia → spiagge · valigia → valigie (or valige)

blocks.note: A mixed group is masculine plural: Dora e Pasquale sono stanchi. Two feminine nouns: feminine plural: le sedie e le finestre sono vecchie.

items.why: Verb and adjective agree with the plural noun.
Accented nouns do not change; and caffè has two f's.
Amico → amici, soft c. (But amica → amiche.)
